sql: SELECT position, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM player WHERE position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') GROUP BY position
nl: Among players with a known position, what is the average age at each position?

sql: SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE nationality != '' GROUP BY nationality
nl: How many players are there for each nationality?

sql: SELECT p.team, AVG(p.nba_championships) AS avg_championships FROM player p JOIN team t ON p.team = t.team_name GROUP BY p.team
nl: For each current NBA team, what is the average number of NBA championships won by its listed players?

sql: SELECT college, MAX(mvp_awards) AS max_mvp_awards FROM player WHERE college != '' GROUP BY college HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
nl: Among colleges with more than one player in the league, what is the highest number of MVP awards won by any of its players?

sql: SELECT position, SUM(mvp_awards) AS total_mvp_awards FROM player WHERE position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') GROUP BY position
nl: Among players with a known position, what is the total number of MVP awards won at each position?

sql: SELECT nationality, MAX(nba_championships) AS max_championships FROM player WHERE nba_championships >= 1 AND nationality != '' GROUP BY nationality
nl: Among players with at least one NBA championship, what is the most championships won by any player of each nationality?

sql: SELECT draft_year, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE draft_year > 2010 GROUP BY draft_year
nl: How many players were drafted in each year after 2010?

sql: SELECT p.team, MIN(p.draft_pick) AS earliest_draft_pick FROM player p JOIN team t ON p.team = t.team_name WHERE p.draft_pick > 0 GROUP BY p.team
nl: For each current NBA team, what is the earliest (lowest) draft pick among its drafted players?

sql: SELECT position, AVG(olympic_gold_medals) AS avg_olympic_golds FROM player WHERE olympic_gold_medals >= 1 AND position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') GROUP BY position
nl: Among players with a known position and at least one Olympic gold medal, what is the average number of Olympic golds at each position?

sql: SELECT college, COUNT(*) AS champion_count FROM player WHERE nba_championships >= 1 AND college != '' GROUP BY college
nl: For each college, how many of its players have won at least one NBA championship?

sql: SELECT p.team, SUM(p.fiba_world_cup) AS total_fiba_titles FROM player p JOIN team t ON p.team = t.team_name WHERE p.fiba_world_cup >= 1 GROUP BY p.team
nl: Among players with at least one FIBA World Cup title, what is the total number of FIBA titles for each current NBA team?

sql: SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE age BETWEEN 20 AND 40 AND nationality != '' GROUP BY nationality
nl: How many players aged 20 to 40 are there for each nationality?

sql: SELECT location, MAX(championship) AS max_championships FROM team WHERE location != '' GROUP BY location
nl: For each city that hosts an NBA team, what is the most championships won by any team there?

sql: SELECT location, COUNT(*) AS team_count FROM team WHERE founded_year < 1970 AND location != '' GROUP BY location
nl: How many teams founded before 1970 are based in each city?

sql: SELECT ownership, SUM(championship) AS total_championships FROM team WHERE ownership != '' GROUP BY ownership
nl: How many championships has each owner’s team(s) won in total?

sql: SELECT location, AVG(championship) AS avg_championships FROM team WHERE championship >= 1 AND location != '' GROUP BY location
nl: Among teams with at least one championship, what is the average number of championships for teams in each city?

sql: SELECT nationality, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM owner GROUP BY nationality
nl: What is the average owner age for each nationality?

sql: SELECT nationality, MIN(own_year) AS earliest_own_year FROM owner WHERE own_year >= 2000 GROUP BY nationality
nl: Among owners who acquired their team in 2000 or later, what is the earliest acquisition year for each nationality?

sql: SELECT state_name, AVG(population) AS avg_population FROM city WHERE state_name != '' GROUP BY state_name
nl: What is the average city population for each state?

sql: SELECT state_name, MAX(gdp) AS max_gdp FROM city WHERE population > 1000000 AND state_name != '' GROUP BY state_name
nl: For each state, what is the highest city GDP among cities in that state with more than one million people?
